stations.title: Staff handbook
stations.note: The rule is one line inside.

captions: At Saltmarsh Paddle Co., Bram needs the one line of the handbook about dogs.
The handbook is eleven articles, and today the box can only hand over a whole one.
You write the code that cuts it into small pieces, in three tasks.
Now the dog rule sits in a short piece that knows its article.
Same handbook, small pieces. Each one says where it came from.
